regression.label: Regression
regression.description: Predicting a continuous numerical value from input features.

decision_flow.question: Is the relationship between features strictly linear?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use Linear Regression or regularized Ridge/Lasso models.
decision_flow.if_no: Consider Gradient Boosted Trees or Random Forest for complex non-linear targets.

classification.label: Classification
classification.description: Predicting discrete class labels from input features.

decision_flow.question: Do you need well-calibrated class probabilities and high interpretability?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Decision Trees or SVM for margin-based separation.

ensemble_learning.label: Ensemble Learning
ensemble_learning.description: Combining multiple base estimators to improve generalization and robustness.

decision_flow.question: Is your tabular dataset complex and prone to high variance?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use Random Forest to bagging trees, or Gradient Boosted Trees for sequential error minimization.
decision_flow.if_no: Start with simpler single estimators like Decision Trees or Logistic Regression.

clustering.label: Clustering
clustering.description: Grouping unlabeled data points into clusters based on similarity metrics.

decision_flow.question: Do you know the exact number of clusters K beforehand?
decision_flow.if_no: Use DBSCAN to auto-detect clusters based on density and isolate outlier noise.

dimensionality_reduction.label: Dimensionality Reduction
dimensionality_reduction.description: Projecting high-dimensional spaces to lower-dimensional latent spaces.

decision_flow.question: Are the feature relationships linear and execution speed is key?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use PCA for linear eigenvalue projections.
decision_flow.if_no: Use UMAP to preserve non-linear topological spaces and cluster layouts.

anomaly_detection.label: Anomaly Detection
anomaly_detection.description: Identifying rare, unexpected patterns or outlier data points.

decision_flow.question: Is your data unlabeled and high-dimensional?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use Isolation Forest to isolate outliers via random tree partitions.
decision_flow.if_no: Consider supervised classifiers with highly skewed class weight calibrations.

time_series.label: Time Series Forecasting
time_series.description: Modeling and predicting sequential, time-dependent data.

decision_flow.question: Are you forecasting a single variable with stable historical trends?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Temporal Fusion Transformers for complex multivariate time covariates.

recommendation.label: Recommendation Systems
recommendation.description: Predicting user preferences and matching relevant items.

decision_flow.question: Is your interaction data purely collaborative ratings?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Two-Tower networks to incorporate rich user and item side-features.
